responsibility: This header implements GCC's bounded bitmap template for small fixed-size bitsets known at compile time. It represents sets as a fixed-length array of `uint64_t` words, provides constexpr recursive operators for bitwise combination, inversion, equality, emptiness testing, and single-bit construction, and marks the type for GCC GC/PCH machinery with no-op handlers. Its role is to provide a compact value-type alternative to dynamic bitmaps when the universe size is statically bounded but may exceed one machine word.
